class.name: IfcRelAssignsToGroup
class.brief_description: The objectified relationship IfcRelAssignsToGroup handles the assignment of object definitions (individual object occurrences as subtypes of IfcObject , and object types as subtypes of IfcTypeObject ) to a group (subtypes of IfcGroup ). The relationship handles the assignment of group members to the group object. It allows for grouping arbitrary objects within a group, including other groups. The

members.member: Reference to group that contains all assigned group members.
